$comment: Business criticality -> criticality factor for the weighted risk score (si_weighted_risk_score = si_risk_score x si_criticality_factor). One vocabulary per CMDB provider; the tenant's ONE CMDB owner decides which applies. Values match case-insensitively. level = the normalised si_cmdb_criticality_level (used by risk factors). Customer overrides: criticality-mapping.custom.json, per provider and value.
$note: Factors equal today's shipped sample (basis-100: Critical 150, High 125, Medium 110, Low 100), so the weighted score does not move for a customer who used the sample.

dataSensitivity.$comment: Optional second input, combined with the criticality factor by "combine" (max | product) and capped by "cap". Empty = criticality only.
